description: After a reload the Join form is empty and shows no notice that an earlier join attempt is pending, although pending-join (with the same operation ID) is still in sessionStorage. Sam must find the original message again. Start, by contrast, pre-fills the name and shows a resume notice.
expected: After reload, Join shows "An earlier attempt to join didn't finish. Paste the same invitation to resume it." (the invitation itself need not be stored).
actual: Empty textarea, no notice; resuming works only if he re-pastes the identical text.
suggested_fix: Render a resume notice when pending-join exists, mirroring pending-create, and switch the toggle to Join automatically.

description: The failure heading is the raw server message "Project authority unavailable; retry this attempt" above a clear friendly hint.
expected: One friendly message: "Lena's computer (the project's hub) is unreachable. Try again when it is back; nothing was lost."
actual: Jargon heading ("Project authority") plus a second explanation.
suggested_fix: Use the hint as the message for HUB_UNAVAILABLE and drop the server string.

description: Right after the join, the board header says "Saved locally · synced" while the switcher entry for the same project says "Saved locally · waiting for hub".
expected: The switcher label for the current project matches the live header status.
actual: Contradictory states shown at the same time.
suggested_fix: Drive switcher labels from the live project status (or omit the label for the current project).
